entities.name: Piperazine reductive amination
observations: 1-Methoxypropan-2-one reacts with the secondary piperazine nitrogen to form a tertiary amino ether side chain.
The aryl/heteroaryl C–I bond is retained; the transformation is not a halide coupling or cyclization.

entities.name: Sodium triacetoxyborohydride
observations: Likely reductant for the inferred reductive amination; database-specific empirical conditions were not found for this exact substrate.

entities.name: Sodium cyanoborohydride
observations: Alternative reductant for reductive amination under mildly acidic conditions.

entities.name: Mildly acidic reductive amination
observations: Likely acetic acid additive in dichloromethane, 1,2-dichloroethane, or methanol at room temperature; molecular sieves may be used.

entities.name: Aryl iodide retained
observations: No oxidant, palladium/copper catalyst, or halide-specific coupling reagent is required for the principal transformation; harsh conditions may cause dehalogenation or undesired coupling.
